domains.category: build, packaging, flashing, and release workflow
domains.scope: repository workflow and board-205 release path; other boards require separate evidence
domains.provenance: behavioral inventory only; reference source remains pinned, read-only, and GPL-covered
domains.non_claim: workflow coverage does not verify firmware behavior or non-205 packaging

domains.category: boot order, system state, task lifecycle, and fail-closed runtime
domains.scope: observable runtime behavior; hardware claims remain board- and evidence-specific
domains.provenance: independent Rust implementation guided by reference behavior and existing admitted evidence
domains.non_claim: inventory and host tests do not verify active hardware control or production mining

domains.category: board profiles, defaults, NVS schema, settings, and credential boundaries
domains.scope: Ultra 205 is primary; every non-205 profile stays separately scoped and unverified
domains.provenance: keys and defaults are behavioral facts; no reference expression is copied into Rust
domains.non_claim: catalog presence and fixtures do not prove non-205 device behavior or live credential use

domains.category: Wi-Fi station, reconnect, scan, IPv6, SoftAP, hostname, and captive DNS
domains.scope: device-user connectivity on all boards; current evidence is limited to board-205 station boot
domains.provenance: reference functions and routes identify observable contracts, not implementation structure
domains.non_claim: station connection evidence does not verify SoftAP, DNS, scanning, IPv6, or reconnect durability

domains.category: ASIC families, serial transport, packets, PLL, frequency, work, and result correlation
domains.scope: BM1366 on Ultra 205 is primary; BM1368, BM1370, and BM1397 remain separate gaps
domains.provenance: protocol facts are independently modeled; safety-critical effects require hardware evidence
domains.non_claim: implemented packet logic and diagnostics do not verify production ASIC actuation or mining

domains.category: Stratum v1/v2, coinbase and address codecs, jobs, sessions, submits, and share outcomes
domains.scope: v1 deterministic behavior is primary; v2 and live share outcomes retain explicit non-claims
domains.provenance: wire behavior and fixtures are independently modeled from reference observations
domains.non_claim: fake-pool outcomes and controlled no-share evidence do not prove accepted or rejected live shares

domains.category: OpenAPI, HTTP commands, settings, theme, WebSocket, logs, static assets, and AxeOS workflows
domains.scope: route and schema contracts are cross-board; live behavior is limited to named evidence claims
domains.provenance: API shapes and routes are behavioral facts; the Angular source remains reference-only
domains.non_claim: route presence and static delivery do not verify full field behavior or browser workflows

domains.category: power telemetry and actuation, voltage, thermal, fan, I2C, and ADC
domains.scope: safety-critical hardware behavior is board-specific and requires exact named-board evidence
domains.provenance: pure safety decisions are independent; hardware driver behavior remains reference evidence
domains.non_claim: read-only telemetry, host tests, and blocked effects do not verify active voltage, fan, or fault behavior

domains.category: display, screen, input, self-test, and Bitaxe accessory protocol
domains.scope: runtime input, self-test, display effects, and BAP hardware are board/evidence specific
domains.provenance: behavioral inventory only; no GPL-covered UI or protocol expression is copied
domains.non_claim: debug display evidence does not verify full screen, input, self-test, or BAP parity

domains.category: retained logging, hashrate, statistics history, scoreboard, and live telemetry
domains.scope: observable statistics and logs; production values require correlated runtime evidence
domains.provenance: response contracts and algorithms are independently modeled from reference behavior
domains.non_claim: zero fixtures and projection markers do not verify production statistics or populated scoreboards

domains.category: filesystem, firmware OTA, web-assets OTA, and recovery
domains.scope: package and route presence are distinct from destructive update and recovery behavior
domains.provenance: observable update contracts are inventoried without executing destructive hardware effects
domains.non_claim: route availability does not verify image validation, rollback, recovery, or interrupted updates

domains.category: claim ladder, redaction, operator evidence, and exact promotion boundaries
domains.scope: repository governance derived from parity risks rather than an upstream firmware subsystem
domains.provenance: project-owned evidence controls; reference commit remains recorded in every qualifying claim
domains.non_claim: governance verification never promotes underlying device behavior by itself
